options.name: --include
options.description: Root-relative candidate pattern; repeatable

options.description: Root-relative exclusion pattern; repeatable

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate artifacts from a Morphir model

options.name: --input
options.description: Model file or Ion tree. Without it, the IR of the most recent morphir compile of the project

options.name: --target
options.description: Registered generation target

options.name: --output
options.description: Owned output directory

options.name: --input-format
options.description: auto, json or ion

options.name: --option
options.description: Backend KEY=VALUE option, repeatable

options.name: --json
options.description: Output one JSON report [default: False]

options.name: --project
options.description: Project directory, workspace member path or project name, for input from a prior compile

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit configuration file, for input from a prior compile

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Out root that holds the compile record; overrides MORPHIR_OUT_DIR and workspace.out_dir

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile source code to Morphir IR

options.name: --language
options.description: Source language, for example fsharp

options.name: --extension
options.description: Frontend extension; overrides [frontend.<language>].extension

options.name: --input
options.description: Source files in compilation order, or one directory

options.name: --project-file
options.description: A build-tool project file that names the ordered sources, for example an .fsproj

options.name: --package-name
options.description: Package name; overrides project.name

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit configuration file

options.name: --project
options.description: Project directory, workspace member path or project name

options.name: --ir-version
options.description: IR format version, for example 3, 4 or 4.0.0; overrides ir.format_version

options.name: --json
options.description: Output one JSON report [default: False]

options.name: --json-lines
options.description: Output compile events as JSON Lines, ending with the report [default: False]

options.name: --types-only
options.description: Not implemented; rejected [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Install a copy of the IR in this directory. Files that an earlier install did not write stay unchanged

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Out root for the compile task; overrides MORPHIR_OUT_DIR and workspace.out_dir

options.name: --target
options.description: Generation target to run on the compiled IR, for example fsharp or csharp

options.name: --generate-output
options.description: Owned output directory of the generation; needed with --target

options.name: --option
options.description: Backend KEY=VALUE option for --target, repeatable
